Hi Alex — thanks for downloading the report and for the note. I'm available Wed 11/18 1:30pm PT or Thu 11/19 9:30am PT for a 30-minute demo. I've attached the ACME-specific benchmark we ran last month so you have it handy.

Agenda (30m):
- Quick intros (3m)
- Benchmark highlights & how we measured latency/cost (7m)
- Live demo focused on batch embeddings pipeline + real-time chat path (12m)
- Next steps / pricing and integration questions (8m)

If one of those times works, I'll send a calendar invite (we use Zoom). If you'd prefer to book directly, here's my scheduling link: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/demo-30m

Note on prep: if you can share rough QPS and average request size for embeddings and expected session lengths for chat, we'll tailor the demo to your numbers.

Attachment: redwood_benchmark_report_Q3.pdf (ACME variant)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

2) Someone from our security team may join — is it possible to include a brief overview of audit logs / SOC2 evidence during the call?

Happy to share our QPS and session length ahead of time — I'll send a short note with numbers tomorrow.

Thanks,
